units.snow_depth_in: inches of snow on the ground

conversion: GHCN-Daily stores tenths of °C and tenths of mm (PRCP), mm (SNOW, SNWD); converted to °F and inches and rounded.
gaps: Blank cells are missing observations; the model fills them from the monthly normals in world.yaml (labelled).
